hero.title: Request Technical Scoping
hero.body: Tell us about your project, and a solutions lead will scope the digital twin, showroom hardware and launch support it needs. We meet at your offices, in person in Riyadh and across the Kingdom, or online.
fitRows: 300+ residential units or 50,000+ m² commercial GFA
hero.fitFooter: Smaller projects are welcome, and we'll tell you if we're the right fit.

form.title: Tell Us About Your Launch
form.body: Best fit: 300+ residential units or 50,000+ m² commercial GFA · Submitted by the developer entity
form.reassurance: A solutions lead replies within 24 hours, Sunday–Thursday.

fields.label: Developer entity*
fields.helper: Must be the developer, not a broker or agency.

fields.label: Masterplan name & location*
fields.placeholder: e.g. Al Narjis Residences, North Riyadh

fields.label: Project scale (units or GFA, m²)*
fields.helper: Best fit: 300+ units or 50,000+ m² GFA.

fields.label: Current technical asset state*
options: Existing 3D model or digital twin (needs upgrade)

form.consent: I agree that Manzili may process this information to respond to my request, as described in the Privacy Policy.
form.nda: Project files are only requested after an NDA is signed.

required: Enter your masterplan name and location.
errors.multi: Choose at least one, or select Software only.
errors.freeMail: Use your company email so we can verify the developer entity.
errors.mobile: Enter a Saudi mobile number starting with 5, e.g. 5X XXX XXXX.
errors.pastDate: Choose a month from now onward.
errors.noNumber: Add a unit count or area in m².
errors.belowThreshold: Projects under 300 units are usually outside our scope. You can still submit and we'll advise.
errors.consent: Agree to the Privacy Policy to continue.

states.successBody: A solutions lead will email you within 24 hours, Sunday–Thursday. Reference: [MZ-0000].
states.successLink: Explore case studies while you wait
states.toast: Request sent. We'll reply within 24 hours.
states.failure: We couldn't send your request. Check your connection and try again, or email sales@manzili.sa.
states.duplicate: We already have a request from this email. We'll be in touch shortly.
states.spam: Please confirm you're not a robot and submit again.

steps.title: We Review Your Request
steps.body: We confirm the project and the developer entity, and a solutions lead replies within 24 hours, Sunday–Thursday.

steps.title: Technical Scoping Session
steps.body: A 60-minute session at your offices or online, where our solutions team reviews your BIM files and showroom needs.

steps.title: Proposal & Master Service Agreement
steps.body: We send a proposal and one Master Service Agreement covering the software, hardware, training and launch support.

details.title: We Come to You
details.body: Our Riyadh office is administrative. We meet developers at their own offices and sales centers, in person in Riyadh and across the Kingdom, or online.

rows.label: Office

rows.label: Launch-day coverage
rows.value: 2-hour dispatch on launch days · 4-hour standard support SLA
